messages:
Ana: Heads-up  ConduitCloud marketplace listing + integration launch. Goal: drive qualified inbound and a joint 45m webinar. Proposed launch week: 2026-04-20.
Priya: I can lead GTM messaging and paid social snippets. Need hero stat & 2 quotes (one partner, one customer).
Marco: Ill manage partner product assets and partner PR intro. Conduit wants a joint FAQ and a 1-min integration demo clip.
Jen: Ill draft blog, two social threads, and the webinar landing page copy. Will need benchmark callouts and a short customer vignette.
Aria: Ops will wire SFDC routing and create a Zap for marketplace leads -> Salesforce campaign. Need final UTMs and form fields.
Ana: Quick deliverable map: 1) Benchmarks + demo clip (eng) 2) Blog draft + social (Jen) 3) Webinar page + registration flow (Priya) 4) Marketplace asset bundle + FAQ (Marco) 5) SFDC routing + UTMs (Aria) 6) Legal/brand signoff (Ana).
Marco: Conduit requests the asset bundle by 2026-04-06. Can we meet that?
Jen: Timeline OK if I get benchmarks and the hero screenshot by 2026-04-02.
Ana: Product team (cc @Liam in PM) can run a focused benchmark. Keep the marketing-friendly stat: reduce per-token cost and steady p95 latency.
Priya: Proposed webinar schedule: 2026-04-21 9am PT, 40m (demo + live Q&A). Panel: Marco (Conduit), Liam (product), Jen (customer Vignette host).
Aria: Routing rules draft (example):
```
utm_source=conduitmarket
utm_medium=marketplace
utm_campaign=conduit-launch-apr2026
on lead create -> assign to SFDC queue 'marketplace_inbound'
if lead.score >= 65 -> convert to MQL and assign AE pool 'integrations'
add CampaignMember to campaign 'Conduit Launch APR 2026'
```
Will spin up a test form and post link.
Marco: Conduit asked for a 60s demo clip that shows "install -> ping -> inference" flow in our Console. Jared (eng) can you help record?
Ana: @Liam / @Jared please prioritize a short scripted demo and a 16:9 hero screenshot. Keep UI blur for sensitive bits.
Jen: Draft blog angle: "Ship smarter: how Redwood + ConduitCloud speed up inference ops"  will include a small sidebar "Benchmark snapshot" and an embedded demo GIF.
Liam: Posting benchmark summary (use copyable snippet):
```
Model: redwood-tf-4B
Sequence: 256
p50: 32ms/token
p95: 98ms/token
Cost estimate: $0.09 / 1k tokens (with batching & cache)
Notes: test ran on gpus: a100-40GB equivalent, 8-token batching
```
Use the shorthand "redwood-tf-4B" in marketing.
Priya: Nice stat. I'll surface the p95 + cost in the hero line and craft a CTA focused on "See it live".
Aria: For SFDC, we'll use campaign=ConduitLaunchApr2026 and set leadSource=Marketplace. Also add lead.tag: co-marketing/conduit.
Ana: Legal needs logos and combined customer quotes for approval by 2026-04-05. Marco, can Conduit confirm a partner quote?
Marco: I'll get Conduit to approve a short quote by 2026-04-03.
Jen: I'll post first blog draft in #marketing-drafts by Mon 2026-03-30 and tag for review.
Priya: Rehearsal plan: dry run 2026-04-19 9am PT. rehearsal-bot: schedule please.
rehearsal-bot: Dry run event created: 2026-04-19 09:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.
Ana: Final asset handoff to Conduit on 2026-04-06. Internal go/no-go check on 2026-04-08.
Marco: One more ask from Conduit: a short checklist for their marketplace admin team (install steps + quick troubleshooting). Jen, can you draft a 1-page checklist?
Jen: Yep, will include it in the asset bundle.
Aria: I'll run lead routing tests end of week and post screenshots of a sample lead in SFDC.
Ana: Thanks team  keep updates here. If blockers, shout out. :rocket:
